story: Mina held a moon atlas, and she wanted to sketch the moon. Jun said, “My whale book is missing.” Mina said, “I promise to help you.” Mina and Jun searched the window nook, but Mina did not find the whale book. Jun spotted the star bookmark on the high shelf. Ms Alvarez reserved the moon atlas for Mina. Ms Alvarez used the ladder to lift the whale book down. Ms Alvarez gave Jun the whale book. Jun said, “I can help you.” Jun opened the moon atlas for Mina. Mina sketched the moon from the moon atlas on the paper. Mina showed Jun the moon drawing.
